Container.Name: Fun-ASR-Nano-API
Container.Overview: OpenAI-compatible Speech-to-Text API powered by Fun-ASR-Nano (800M, FunAudioLLM). 31 languages, Chinese dialects, hotwords, streaming-capable. Switch between Fun-ASR-Nano (full features) and Fun-ASR-MLT (31 languages including European) via MODEL_ID. First start downloads model from HuggingFace. China users: set HF_ENDPOINT to https://hf-mirror.com. Requires NVIDIA GPU with driver 550+.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible STT API port. Swagger docs at /docs

Config.Name: Model Cache
Config.Description: Model download cache. Persists across container recreates.

Config.Name: Model ID
Config.Description: Fun-ASR-Nano-2512 (full features, dialects, hotwords) or FunAudioLLM/Fun-ASR-MLT-Nano-2512 (31 languages including European).

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Default language: auto, 中文, English, 日文, etc. Per-request override via API parameter.

Config.Name: Enable VAD
Config.Description: Voice Activity Detection. Segments long audio into utterances. Recommended for files longer than 30s.

Config.Name: Enable Speaker Diarization
Config.Description: Identify who is speaking. Adds ~7MB speaker model. Results in verbose_json format.

Config.Name: HuggingFace Endpoint
Config.Description: HuggingFace download endpoint. China users: change to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads.
